title: Unveiling atomic-scale mechanisms of tantalum-based 2D materials for high-performance Li–S batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01110H, Paper
Shrish Nath Upadhyay, Jayant K. Singh
The development of effective electrocatalysts is vital for advancing lithium–sulfur (Li–S) batteries, particularly in addressing sluggish redox kinetics and the polysulfide shuttle effect.
